evidence.title: Alonso encouraged by Aston Martin's updates, but still wants more from Honda
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Honda brought a new specification of power unit to Zandvoort, one race after Aston Martin delivered its own significant chassis update in Budapest prior to the summer shutdown. [e001:f02] Following a further evolution of those new parts that was also introduced in the Netherlands, Alonso said is pleased with the car's progress but wants more from the power unit. [e001:f03] “Yeah, definitely [a step forward] on the chassis,” Alonso said. [e001:f04] “I think we brought more new parts here and in the race, the car was very easy to drive, very easy on tires. [e001:f05] That's definitely a benefit there. [e001:f06] So, everything that we are bringing from the chassis side is delivering performance on track. [e001:f07] “On the engine side, it will be more difficult as we don't have a clear comparison to the previous spec. [e001:f08] Obviously, we are in the points, so maybe there is more power and we need to take it. [e001:f09] But still, especially on the drivability side, we need to improve and to get a little bit of consistency that seems that we lost with this spec, too.” Aston Martin’s previous point was scored in Monaco courtesy of post-race penalties for other drivers that promoted Alonso into 10th place. [e001:f10] But after finishing ninth on track in Zandvoort, he said the team deserves praise for the way it managed the race. [e001:f11] “I'm very happy," he said. [e001:f12] "Happy for the team, as I think they nailed all the strategy was the right one, the starting tire was the right one. [e001:f13] At the end (there were) a couple of Virtual Safety Cars, so we were debating if stopping or not. [e001:f14] So, I think all the decisions they made were the correct ones. [e001:f15] “Thanks to that mix, we are in the points. [e001:f16] Hopefully, we keep this momentum into the next few races, and big congratulations to everyone.” * * * ###### Topics [aston martin](http:// alonso](http:// grand prix](http:// 1](http:// update](http:// 1](http://。

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e002:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e002:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e002:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e002:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e002:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e002:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e002:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e002:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e002:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e002:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e002:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

evidence.title: Triple FIA Dutch GP investigation; new Lewis Hamilton evidence emerges
evidence.body: [e004:f01] Let’s blast through the day’s main headlines at breakneck speed… Conclusions from the Dutch Grand Prix McLaren driver and reigning world champion Lando Norris claimed a second consecutive win at the Dutch Grand Prix. [e004:f02] Norris picked up from where he left off in Hungary with a fine victory at Zandvoort. [e004:f03] Mercedes pair Kimi Antonelli and George Russell finished second and third respectively. [e004:f04] The four-time world champion retired early after losing control and striking the wall at the final corner. [e004:f05] Hamilton became agitated while stuck behind teammate Charles Leclerc, with Ferrari slow to swap the order. [e004:f06] The seven-time world champion was eventually forced to settle for fourth place. [e004:f07] The pair were given two penalty points, in addition to drive-through penalties, for overtaking under double yellow flags. [e004:f08] Colapinto picked up an additional point for failing to obey yellow flags later in the race. [e004:f09] Alonso claimed Aston Martin’s second points finish of the F1 2026 season by finishing ninth. [e004:f10] Newey, who was appointed Aston Martin team principal last year, is not often heard over team radio. [e004:f11] Join our broadcast channel on WhatsApp to get the scoop on the latest developments from our team of accredited journalists. evidence.title: FIA announce three post-race penalties at Dutch Grand Prix
evidence.body: [e005:f01] The FIA confirmed post-race penalties for three F1 stars at the Dutch Grand Prix on Sunday. [e005:f02] The race stewards were kept busy throughout the action in Zandvoort, and it all started at the end of the first racing lap after a big crash for four-time world champion Max Verstappen . [e005:f03] They continued to work hard after the black and white checkered flag, too, with the FIA revealing a number of penalty verdicts after Lando Norris had taken Sunday's victory. [e005:f04] Article continues under video F1 RESULTS: Full times, finishing positions and penalties from Dutch Grand Prix FIA confirm penalties at Dutch Grand Prix Carlos Sainz punished for crashing with teammate Williams star Carlos Sainz was one of the names to be punished in Zandvoort, handed a 10-second time penalty for causing a collision with his teammate, Alex Albon. [e005:f05] Heading into turn one, Sainz locked up his tyres with Albon on the outside, with the stewards deeming that the Spaniard was wholly at fault for the incident. [e005:f06] "The driver of Car 55 defended an overtaking attempt by Car 23 on the inside into Turn 1, but locked up and caused a collision between both cars. [e005:f07] The Stewards determine that the driver of Car 55 was wholly at fault and issue the standard penalty for such incidents," the FIA confirmed. [e005:f08] F1 stars penalised for yellow flag infringements The other two penalties applied post-race were handed to Liam Lawson and Franco Colapinto for yellow flag infringements. [e005:f09] After reviewing the evidence, the race stewards determined that both Lawson and Colapinto failed to slow for a single yellow flag in turn three - a breach of article B1.8.4a of the FIA F1 regulations. [e005:f10] Both drivers received a 10-second penalty as a result, as well as one penalty point. [e005:f11] The verdicts for both were identical, with the FIA confirming: "The Stewards reviewed video, timing, telemetry and in-car video evidence. [e005:f12] Car 43/Car 30 passed a single yellow flag without discernibly reducing speed although also receiving a visible warning on the dash. [e005:f13] As the infringement was not considered dangerous or egregious, a penalty on the lower end of the available scale is imposed." With the penalties applied, Lawson finished in seventh, while Colapinto was classified in 14th. [e005:f14] Other FIA penalty verdicts at Dutch GP It was the second time that Colapinto was on the wrong side of the rules in Zandvoort, with the Alpine driver having also been handed a drive-through penalty and two penalty points early in the race, along with Arvid Lindblad , after overtaking under a double yellow. [e005:f15] Those incidents occurred after the red flag for Max Verstappen 's crash, but the race stewards' decision was confirmed post-race by the FIA. evidence.title: フェルスタッペンがレッドブルと2030年までの契約延長を発表 新PU次第で31年以降は未定「FIAとも、たくさんの話し合いをしてきた」
evidence.body: [e006:f01] 31年以降もF1を継続するかどうは次のパワーユニットレギュレーション次第になることも明かし、「2030年になったとき、V8エンジンの導入の可能性も含めて、もう一度考えることになる」とオランダGP開幕前日の記者会見で話した。 [e006:f02] 【動画】高速レースで見せたドライビング！ [e006:f03] 角田裕毅の快走シーン 今季からF1の車両規則が大幅に変わり、熱エネルギー回生装置（MGU―H）が廃止され、内燃機関（ICE）と電動モーター（MGU−K）の出力バランスが改まったことで充電の駆け引きが左右されるようになり、選手の中には一時は「マリオカート」だと批判する声が相次いだ。 [e006:f04] フェルスタッペンも新レギュレーションに対して懸念を抱いていた1人で、F1からの引退の可能性もちらつかせて、「（別の）チームに変えるよりは、引退する方に心が近づいていたと思うよ」。 [e006:f05] 他チームに移籍する考えはなく、残留か引退の2択だったことを明かした。 [e006:f06] チームは昨季までホンダのパワーユニットを使用してきたが、今季から自社開発の「レッドブル・フォード」にスイッチ。 [e006:f07] 実戦でデータを積む他メーカーと比べて苦戦が予想されたが、今季は優勝こそないものの、フェルスタッペンはオーストリア、ハンガリーで2位、カナダ、ベルギーで3位を獲得し、シリーズランキングもオランダGP前の時点で6位。 [e006:f08] 「FIA（国際自動車連盟）とも、たくさんの話し合いをしてきた。 [e006:f09] 僕たちは少しずつ、より良いものへ向かって進んでいるとみる」と話し、将来への前向きな見通しを感じることができているという。 [e006:f10] デビューしたのは姉妹チームのトロロッソ（現レーシングブルズ）ながら、レッドブルグループの一員として13年間F1のステアリングを握り続けており、このままいけばキャリアが17年に延びることになる。 [e006:f11] 大ベテランのルイス・ハミルトンもマクラーレンで6年、メルセデスで12年過ごし、メルセデスエンジンユーザーとして18年活動したが、昨季からフェラーリに電撃移籍。 [e006:f12] 今年6月のバルセロナ・カタルーニャGPで新天地初優勝を遂げた。 [e006:f13] フェルスタッペンも2031年からの新レギュレーション次第でレッドブル以外のチームに移って新境地を見いだす可能性はある。 [e006:f14] 外部サイト “代打”角田裕毅の快走は「驚きじゃない」 天才フェルスタッペンが指摘したF1で僅差が生まれる理由「新マシンは限界を見極めるのが前よりずっと簡単」 「シャシーは非常に良い。 [e006:f15] でもストレートでは抜けない」オランダGP予選でも下位に沈んだアストンマーティン アロンソは現マシンへの複雑な想いを吐露「ここ2戦で3秒縮まった」「さらなる改善が必要」 “空白の8か月”で失ったヒリヒリ感 角田裕毅がぶっつけ本番でレッドブル組も凌駕する好走 幹部も感嘆した“急成長”「驚くほど早くマシン特性を習得した」 日々快適に、そして各々が目指す結果に向けてサポートするマガジンとして、多くの方々の「ココロ」と「カラダ」のコンディショニングを整えるのに参考になる媒体(誌面＆WEB)を目指していきます。

evidence.title: ジョージ・ラッセルはロバート・リードの退任後のFIAの「不安定さ」を非難した
evidence.body: [e002:f01] モハメド・ベン・スレイエム会長とF1 ドライバーの関係は緊張しており、改善の見込みはなさそうだ。 [e002:f02] 物議を醸しているFIA会長は、木曜日に右腕のロバート・リード氏が突然辞任したことを受け、新たな論争の中心に立たされている。 [e002:f03] 英国人のリード氏は、痛烈な声明の中で「モータースポーツの世界統括団体における統治基準の根本的な崩壊」を非難し、辞任した。 [e002:f04] 「重要な決定が適正な手続きや適切な協議なしに行われていることに、私たちはますます危機感を抱いています。 [e002:f05] 私が就任した目的は、権力者ではなく、FIA会員のために尽くすことでした。 [e002:f06] しかし、時が経つにつれ、私たちが守ると誓った原則が着実に損なわれていくのを目の当たりにしてきました」と ロバート・リード氏は断言した。 [e002:f07] 「 FIAが代表するべき組織や人々を顧みることなく、密室で決定が下されています。 [e002:f08] FIAを去ることは容易ではありませんが、留まることは私が真に信じるものを妥協することになります。 [e002:f09] これは政治ではなく、原則の問題です。 [e002:f10] モータースポーツは、誠実さ、説明責任、そして手続きへの敬意に基づいた統治を受けるに値します。 [e002:f11] これは、私たち全員が期待し、要求すべき最低限の基準です。 [e002:f12] 」 彼の突然の予期せぬ離脱は、シーズン第4戦に向けて準備を進めているバーレーンのパドックにいる F1 ドライバーたちの間で様々な反応を引き起こした。 [e002:f13] GPDA（グランプリドライバーズ協会）会長のジョージ・ラッセルは、FIA内部の不安定さを示すこの最新の事例を非難した。

evidence.title: アステモ、新社長にホンダ四輪本部長の井上勝史氏 竹内弘平社長は退任 ホンダ四輪事業の立て直しを全面支援
evidence.body: [e005:f01] 6月25日の定時株主総会と7月1日の臨時取締役会を経て正式決定する。 [e005:f02] 井上氏はホンダの欧州や中国の責任者などを経て、電動事業開発部門のトップ、昨年4月には四輪事業本部長に就いたが、6月にホンダの取締役退任が決まっていた。 [e005:f03] ホンダは日立が保有するアステモの株式21％分を取得し、出資比率を61％に引き上げて子会社化する予定でいる。 [e005:f04] 電気自動車（EV）戦略の失敗で業績が悪化している同社は、ソフトウエア・デファインド・ビークル（SDV）やハイブリッド車（HV）に重点を置く方針に軌道修正した。 [e005:f05] アステモはSDVや電動車向けを含むパワートレイン技術に強い。 [e005:f06] ホンダはアステモの先進技術や開発力を高く評価しており、連携を強化する。 [e005:f07] 今回、ホンダの四輪事業部門で実務経験の長い井上氏にトップ交代することで、ホンダの四輪事業の立て直しについて、系列サプライヤーとして全面的に支える体制を整える。 [e005:f08] 竹内社長もホンダ出身で、2023年7月にアステモの社長に就いた。 [e005:f09] ホンダでは財務・管理部門が長く、アステモでは前任社長時代の品質問題を踏まえた対応や財務体質の改善、株式公開に向けた準備などを担ってきた。 [e005:f10] 井上勝史氏（いのうえ・かつし）1986年3月、横浜国立大学経営学部卒、同年4月ホンダ入社。 [e005:f11] 2015年ホンダカーズインディア社長、16年ホンダ執行役員、欧州地域本部長、20年常務執行役員兼中国本部長兼本田技研工業（中国）投資総経理兼本田技研科技（中国）総経理、23年執行役専務兼電動事業開発本部長、25年取締役執行役専務兼四輪事業本部長兼リスクマネジメントオフィサー、25年6月同取締役執行役専務、26年4月同取締役。

Falcon 9 booster B1067 was originally built around a goal of at least ten flights without major refurbishment. It has now launched and landed 36 times in barely five years—only thr
evidence.body: [e001:f01] It has now launched and landed 36 times in barely five years—only three flights short of the 39 missions Space Shuttle Discovery accumulated across its entire 27-year career. [e001:f02] NASA’s live account made a point of saying so, then showed the booster landing on the drone ship _Of Course I Still Love You_ about eight minutes after launch. [e001:f03] Five years and 36 days later, [on 9 July 2026](https:// it rose from Cape Canaveral again. [e001:f04] The landing completed B1067’s 36th trip up and 36th controlled return. [e001:f05] The booster separated, the upper stage continued towards orbit, and B1067 touched down at sea about eight and a half minutes after leaving Florida. [e001:f06] Thirty-six flights put one Falcon 9 first stage within three missions of space shuttle Discovery’s lifetime total of 39. [e001:f07] That is a useful comparison, but only if the two things being counted are kept clear. ## Thirty-six launches are not 36 shuttle missions B1067 is one reusable part of Falcon 9. [e001:f08] It is misleading if treated as proof that a first stage has done almost everything an orbiter did. ## One flight every 53 days across five years The elapsed time from B1067’s first launch to its 36th was 1,861 days and almost 16 hours. [e001:f09] It remained useful through five years of launch assignment, pad processing, ocean landings, port returns, transport, inspection and maintenance. [e001:f10] B1067 later launched Crew-4 as well, sending a total of eight astronauts towards the International Space Station across those two flights. [e001:f11] Two NASA cargo missions, two crew launches, commercial communications spacecraft and European navigation hardware all appear in one stage’s logbook. [e001:f12] By the 36th launch, however, Starlink supplied 25 of its missions, including the latest one. [e001:f13] It helps explain how a booster acquires 36 flights in five years. ## What the original ten-flight goal actually meant Falcon 9 Block 5 debuted in May 2018 as the final major version of the rocket. [e001:f14] SpaceX’s public ambition was that a first stage should manage at least ten flights without major refurbishment. [e001:f15] Earlier Falcon 9 versions had already landed and reflown, but Block 5 was designed so reuse shaped the hardware from the beginning. [e001:f16] B1067’s 36 flights do not show that the original ten-flight estimate was wrong.

evidence.title: Analyst to SpaceX Investors: You're Valuing SpaceX Like AI Is Almost Worthless
evidence.body: [e002:f01] A funny thing happened when **Space Exploration Technologies**(NASDAQ: SPCX) reported earnings this month. [e002:f02] This Rare Signal Is Flashing Again.**In 2009, a "Double Down" signal flashed for a little-known chipmaker called Nvidia. [e002:f03] For the first time in years, that same "Total Conviction" signal is flashing for a company 1/100th the size of Nvidia. [**Continue »**](https:// Potentially worse news for investors, the earnings announcement [triggered a "lock-up" expiration](https:// permitting SpaceX insiders to sell 20% of their stock. [e002:f04] A second lock-up expires later this week, when SpaceX passes the 70-days-after-IPO mark, allowing another 7% of the stock to be sold. [e002:f05] It recovered all its losses and by Wednesday's close was back above its IPO price and trading for $140 a share. [e002:f06] And one Wall Street analyst thinks this is only the beginning of the rally for SpaceX stock. ! [e002:f07] It has no profit to back _up_ that valuation, granted, thanks to an [artificial intelligence division](https:// that's losing more than $1 billion per quarter -- and [burning through tens of billions of dollars per year](https:// But that doesn't scare **Morgan Stanley** one bit. [e002:f08] In a note released last week, MS analyst Adam Jonas argues that SpaceX's non-AI businesses alone support nearly all of the present value of SpaceX stock, based on a combination of forecast sales and "earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation, and amortization" ([EBITDA](https:// To hear Jonas tell it, SpaceX AI comes basically free of charge on top of what investors are already paying for the rest of SpaceX. ## Valuing SpaceX as a sum of its parts Here's how the math works. [e002:f09] Over the past 12 months, the Space and Connectivity divisions of SpaceX -- essentially, everything not AI -- generated a combined $17.9 billion in sales and $8.6 billion in EBITDA, according to data from [S&P Global Market Intelligence](https:// AI generated $5.1 billion in sales, but negative EBITDA of $313 million. [e002:f10] Valuing the stock at 52 times 2028 EBITDA, and reverse-engineering Jonas' math, implies a forecast of $31.5 billion in EBITDA for Space and Connectivity in 2028 -- a 266% increase in just two years. [e002:f11] Meanwhile, consensus estimates on Wall Street have SpaceX as a whole generating $126.8 billion in EBITDA in 2028. [e002:f12] Backing out the $31.5 billion contribution from Space and Connectivity, the AI division flips from a loss today to a $95.3 billion EBITDA _profit_ just two years from now. ## How to value SpaceXAI This is a bold prediction. [e002:f13] Assuming these estimates are correct, investors are valuing Space and Connectivity EBITDA at a 52 multiple. [e002:f14] Well, $162 billion might seem like a fair price to pay for an AI business currently generating _negative_ EBITDA. [e002:f15] But if two years of [hypergrowth](https:// grow SpaceX's AI division to the point that it's generating 75% of SpaceX's profit, you'd expect investors would happily pay a much higher price for it. [e002:f16] Before you buy stock in Space Exploration Technologies, consider this: The _Motley Fool Stock Advisor_ analyst team just identified what they believe are the **[10 best stocks](https://。

[e004:f14] Assuming these estimates are correct, investors are valuing Space and Connectivity EBITDA at a 52 multiple. [e004:f15] Well, $162 billion might seem like a fair price to pay for an AI business currently generating negative EBITDA. [e004:f16] But if two years of hypergrowth grow SpaceX's AI division to the point that it's generating 75% of SpaceX's profit, you'd expect investors would happily pay a much higher price for it.

[e003:f04] The 2026 IPO window blew open this summer. [e003:f05] For investors who want cohort exposure without picking single names, the Renaissance IPO ETF ( NYSEARCA:IPO ) is the cleanest vehicle. [e003:f06] IPO shares closed near $54 on Monday, up about 18% year to date but down roughly 6% over the past week, a reminder that this basket moves with risk appetite in both directions. [e003:f07] What You Actually Own in the IPO ETF Right Now The fund is a rules-based basket of the largest, most liquid US-listed IPOs from roughly the past three years, with a defined holding period and quarterly rebalances. [e003:f08] The top three positions as of March 31, 2026 are Kenvue at 10%, CoreWeave at 9%, and ARM Holdings at 7%, with Reddit at 7% and Astera Labs at 6% close behind. [e003:f09] Macro Factor: IPO Issuance Velocity and Risk Appetite The single biggest driver over the next 12 months is the pace of new large-cap listings and the market's appetite to bid them up on day one. [e003:f10] When the window is open, as it has been since the SpaceX debut, later entrants like Anthropic and a potential OpenAI filing pull capital toward recent IPOs across the board. [e003:f12] A useful threshold: if two or more issuers priced at $10 billion or above break issue price within their first month, that has historically signaled a cooling window, and this fund has tended to lag broad indexes through those stretches. evidence.title: SpaceX hits 100th Falcon launch of the year with a 27-satellite Starlink mission (watch video)
evidence.body: [e005:f01] BY ANKITA GARKOTI PUBLISHED 2 DAYS AGO Image of Falcon 9 lifting off from California with 27 Starlink satellites, marking SpaceX’s 100th Falcon launch of the year. (Cover Image Source: SpaceX) In another milestone, SpaceX has completed its 100th Falcon rocket mission of 2026. [e005:f02] The milestone was reached after the latest Falcon 9 rocket lifted off at 3:25 a.m. [e005:f03] EDT from Vandenberg Space Force Base in California with 27 Starlink satellites. [e005:f04] This marked the 99th Falcon 9 mission of the year. [e005:f05] The satellites now circle the planet a few hundred miles above the surface. [e005:f06] Including a single Falcon Heavy mission from April, which carried the Viasat-3 F3 communications satellite, the total number of Falcon rockets SpaceX has launched this year comes down to 100. [e005:f07] Falcon 9 lifts off from California and delivers 27 @Starlink satellites to orbit, completing our 100th Falcon launch of the year — SpaceX (@SpaceX) August 22, 2026 Commenting on the achievement, SpaceX posted on X, "Falcon 9 lifts off from California and delivers 27 @Starlink satellites to orbit, completing our 100th Falcon launch of the year." About 8.5 minutes after liftoff, the Falcon 9's first-stage booster separated and successfully landed upright on a floating platform in the Pacific Ocean called "Of Course I Still Love You." The booster used, which is known by the designation B1100, was flying for the ninth time. [e005:f08] Watch Falcon 9 launch 27 @Starlink satellites to orbit from California https:// — SpaceX (@SpaceX) August 22, 2026 In a conversation, Elon Musk said, "With respect to space, I think there’s really just one problem, which is a fully and rapidly reusable orbital rocket. [e005:f09] SpaceX flew its Falcon rockets 165 times in 2025 alone. [e005:f10] With roughly four months still left in 2026, the company is expected to keep pace with that number. [e005:f11] Of the 99 Falcon 9 launches so far this year, 76 have gone toward growing the Starlink network , which now counts more than 11,000 active satellites. [e005:f12] Starlink now has 11k satellites in orbit https:// — Elon Musk (@elonmusk) August 21, 2026 Next up, SpaceX aims to launch its next-generation Starlink V3 satellites, with a goal of eventually reaching 100,000 in orbit. [e005:f13] That plan depends heavily on Starship, the company's next-generation rocket, which is still being tested. [e005:f14] SpaceX is currently preparing for Flight 14 , which will send Starship on a full orbital mission for the first time. [e005:f15] The flight is expected no earlier than August 28, 2026. [e005:f16] The Starship preparing for our fourteenth flight test completed a full-duration, 60-second static fire with all six Raptor engines — SpaceX (@SpaceX) August 21, 2026 SpaceX president Gwynne Shotwell shared, “The significant amount of capacity we're able to add to the Starlink constellation from the V3 satellites will enable us to continue providing even better service—I think it's pretty great already—but to do so while serving more and more customers all over the world." More on Starlust: No Starship catch using tower on flight 14, says SpaceX CEO Elon Musk; eyes over 30 launches per day Stream NASA's Moon base construction in 4K: Blue Origin's Lunar Express could make it possible。

evidence.title: SpaceX valuation faces skepticism amid Starship delays and pressure on Starlink margins
evidence.body: [e006:f01] SpaceX holds a high valuation driven by strong investor interest and the 'Musk Premium,' but skepticism remains due to fundamental challenges. [e006:f02] Delays in the Starship project pose a major risk, as its success is crucial for reducing costs and enabling future growth through new satellite constellations. [e006:f03] Starlink accounts for 62% of SpaceX's revenue with rapid user growth, yet average revenue per user (ARPU) is declining and gross margins are squeezed by high depreciation, amortization, and launch costs. [e006:f04] The analyst rates SpaceX as a Hold, highlighting execution risks, uncertain returns on major projects, and the need to watch Starship progress and data center deals closely.

evidence.title: Paratus launches Starlink satellite services in Uganda
evidence.body: [e001:f01] Paratus Uganda said the integration of Starlink services to its network further enhances its offering in the country, including resilient cross-border connectivity via the 2,000-km Goma-to-Mombasa (G2M) route and Paratus Group’s East-West Southern Africa backbone, redundancy solutions and value-added network services. [e001:f02] Paratus Uganda launched services in November 2025 via a joint venture between Paratus Group and Kampala-based ISP Roke Telkom . [e001:f03] Paratus Uganda country manager Edwin Kyambadde said with Starlink in its portfolio, the operator is activating a strong pipeline of customers across numerous sectors, including mining, healthcare, tourism, NGOs and government, many of which require dependable connectivity in remote and underserved areas. [e001:f04] “There has been significant demand for LEO services from enterprise customers who have been waiting for Starlink to become available in Uganda,” Kyambadde said in a statement. [e001:f05] “Now that Starlink is licensed, the hard work begins as we connect customers across the country. [e001:f06] This is a powerful addition to our network and it’s a game-changer for businesses operating beyond traditional infrastructure reach.” Paratus Group chief commercial officer Martin Cox said the Starlink licence approval further enhances the group’s strategy of building a contiguous, multi-layered network across Africa under its Paratus 500 brand , adding that Uganda is the ninth market where Paratus is reselling Starlink services under a distribution agreement signed in 2023 . [e001:f07] “With Starlink now available through Paratus Uganda, we can offer customers not only in Uganda, but also across the East African region, even greater resilience, faster deployment and truly borderless connectivity,” Cox said. [e001:f08] Right after the UCC approved Starlink’s licence in May, Airtel Uganda announced it has begun testing Starlink’s direct-to-cell (D2C) LEO satellite service as part of Airtel Africa’s deal with SpaceX in December 2025 to launch Starlink’s D2C in all of its 14 markets this year. [e001:f09] Under the UCC’s licence conditions, Starlink must deploy a national gateway with a physical point of presence in Uganda, ensure that all devices activated in the country are properly registered, and maintain an operational office in Uganda with critical technical, legal and support staff.
